hypothesis: The multiscale-trained student's novel reliable cues may survive a fresh 2x magnified context even if the old teacher cannot recognize them
proposal_rule: Existing student_consistent additions not overlapping accepted cross_model_supported selection; at most 6; source-only selection unchanged
student_context: Two distinct 640px windows shifted -80/+80, input960; each same-class score > .75, each box IoU >= .5 with original student seed and pair IoU >= .5; artificial-edge margin16
selection: Preserve all teacher and previously accepted student cues, add original student seed coordinates only in remaining supplementary slots
training_acceptance: 32 train controls: >67/98 TP, unmatched0, normal cues0; reject with no heldout evaluation if no positive gain
holdout_acceptance: inner >61/80 TP, unmatched0; outer>=31/56 TP, unmatched<=1; normal cues do not increase
